summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director Douglas Davis, effective immediately in July 2026. The filing states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices. No terms, compensation, or replacement were mentioned. The departure appears voluntary and non-confrontational, with no indication of board conflict. As a single director resignation without stated controversy, this is a routine governance disclosure. What to watch: whether the company names a successor and whether any further departures signal broader instability.
